scripts.build: sh -ec 'echo "Validating CPI artifacts..."; FILE=$(find iflows -name "*.zip" -type f -printf "%T@ %p\n" | sort -n | tail -1 | cut -d" " -f2-); test -n "$FILE"; BASENAME=$(basename "$FILE"); echo "Processing $FILE"; unzip -t "$FILE"; mkdir -p dist; cp "$FILE" "dist/$BASENAME"; NEXUS_USER="admin"; test -n "$nexus_password"; test -n "$ARTIFACT_URL"; echo "Uploading to Nexus..."; curl --fail --show-error --silent -u "$NEXUS_USER:$nexus_password" -T "dist/$BASENAME" "$ARTIFACT_URL/$BASENAME"; echo "Uploaded successfully"'
